Are you passionate about developing advanced microwave oscillator systems for world-class Doppler radar solutions?

At Weibel, you will become part of a growing, technology-driven company where curiosity, innovation, and dedication are the foundation of our global success. We develop and manufacture high-performance radar systems at our in-house production facilities, enabling us to explore new solutions while maintaining uncompromising quality. Our greatest asset is our talented employees, who work in a modern environment and continuously advance our market-leading radar solutions for applications such as air surveillance and precision tracking.

We are strengthening our Antenna R&D Group and are looking for a Senior Microwave Engineer to join us as we enter a new growth phase.

About the position

As our new colleague, you will drive the development of microwave oscillators from early concept through design, integration, and deployment into our radar systems. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across analog, digital, and mechanical engineering disciplines. In addition, you will contribute to architectural improvements in collaboration with our system architects.

Your primary responsibilities include:

• Designing, developing, and optimizing oscillator modules and circuitry for high-performance radar applications.

• Researching and evaluating new oscillator technologies to improve phase noise, frequency stability, and overall system performance.

• Serving as the technical subject-matter expert for oscillator designs and their integration.

• Supporting prototype assembly, testing, and DFM reviews to ensure successful transfer to production.

• Providing technical support to in-house production and customers through engineering guidance, root-cause analysis, and documentation.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the frequency-generation foundation of Weibel's radar portfolio and enhance the performance of our next-generation radar systems.

About you

You thrive in an Agile environment, where you work both independently and in close collaboration with your team and cross-functional stakeholders. You value continuous learning and are comfortable operating in a dynamic R&D setting with multiple parallel activities, some requiring immediate attention and others progressing through structured project plans.

Your qualifications include:

• An M.Sc. or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field, preferably with a specialization in RF or microwave hardware design.

• Hands-on experience with oscillator and frequency-generation design, e.g., VCOs, DROs, or PLL-based synthesizers, including optimization of phase noise, frequency stability, and spectral purity.

• A strong background in RF, microwave, or mixed-signal systems development, combined with a solid understanding of the full product development lifecycle.

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements (e.g., radio and EMC) and military standards applied in mission-critical industries.

• Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Furthermore, you are comfortable leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve engineering efficiency and quality.

Your new team

Our team consists of over 10 engaged colleagues, with experience ranging from a few years to more than 35 years in radar engineering. The team is part of our cross-functional Antenna R&D Group, bringing together architects and design specialists across RF, analog, digital, and mechanical domains to deliver cutting-edge radar technology.

Contact and application

Please submit your application via our website using the “Apply” button. If you have any questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Engineering Manager, Adin Kanlic, at adk@weibel.dk.

The application deadline is 16 November.

Please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis.

Employment in this role is subject to the ability to provide a clean criminal record and to obtain the required security clearance.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Become part of a Danish company

Weibel Scientific A/S is a Danish-owned engineering company experiencing strong growth. We develop and manufacture high‑technology radar systems for use in areas such as space research, aviation, defense, and the protection of critical infrastructure. We are a world leader in the development of Doppler radars and, since our establishment in 1977, we have delivered more than 4,500 state‑of‑the-art radar systems to over 40 countries.

Our headquarters are located in Allerød and employ nearly 600 people.

At Weibel, you can look forward to an exciting and challenging position in a dynamic and forward‑looking company with in‑house production and advanced technological development.

Read more about us on our website.

Do you have experience with planning and testing complex systems?

At Weibel you will join a truly technology driven company that delivers excellent Doppler Radars across the world. Weibel is recognized as a world-leader in radar technology, with our radars performing with a precision largely unmatched by competitors. Applications for our radars include Space Research, Missile Defence, Instrumentation Systems and lately for drone and UAS detection. Our radars are produced at our HQ in Allerød, north of Copenhagen.

Increasing customer demand means that the company is experiencing rapid growth. As part of this, we are extending our leadership team in our System Integration, Test & Verification team with one more experienced System Test Manager.

Oversee the system test of our state-of-the-art radars

As System Test Manager you take ownership of system test activities across the development lifecycle of our advanced radar products. In this leadership role you will plan, prioritize, and drive the work of one or maybe a few Scrum teams of test engineers, ensuring that integrated hardware and software meet system requirements, performance targets, quality standards, and customer expectations.

You will be part of a test leadership team comprising four System Test Managers. Each manager supports a dedicated program with deliveries based on our radar platforms and owns the test plan for the projects in the program. Coordination with the other three test managers is therefore also relevant to inspire and maximize reuse to continuously improve testing and execute as efficiently as possible.

Key responsibilities:

• Plan and drive the execution of integration, functional, performance, robustness, environmental and regression testing through one or more Scrum teams of test engineers.

• Define test scope and methods and translate program priorities and test needs into clear team objectives, backlogs, milestones, dependencies, and delivery expectations.

• Align with the other System Test Managers on shared methods, mechanisms and specialist resources.

• Establish test readiness criteria, and communicate product maturity, coverage, results, and residual risks to the Technical Project Manager in the Program

• Drive automation, repeatability, data quality, and continuous improvement in test processes.

• Support customer demonstrations, qualification activities, and formal acceptance testing when required.

• Act as a technical lead and mentor for a team of System Test Engineers, and be part of creating a culture with focus on quality and continuous improvement

• Collaborate with Mechanical, Hardware and Software development teams to define test requirements and ensure seamless integration

• Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements

About you

You thrive in an environment that requires you to work independently on some tasks and in close collaboration with your colleagues across the entire company on others. You have excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a detailed-oriented mindset. You show initiative and drive, take responsibility, have strong communication skills, work effectively across teams and dare to challenge the team to ensure high quality. You understand how the Scrum methodology applies in a system test context.

Your CV include:

• A relevant engineering degree

• 10+ years of experience in system testing of complex integrated HW and SW systems

• Proven technical leadership experience, managing test teams in an agile development environment

• Experience working with Requirements and Test management tools (we use Helix)

• Strong understanding of test automation tools, frameworks, and methodologies

• Experience with systems engineering in relation to complex systems

• Relevant certifications (e.g. ISTQB) is an advantage

• Fluent in English both written and spoken

• Experience with radar systems or complex systems for military use, is considered an advantage

Your new team

You will be joining our team of more than 25 colleagues in the Integration, Test & Verification team. Our responsibilities span across system integration and testing as well as qualification of our products and we are divided into two competency domains. Each domain is represented by an Engineering Manager in the Test Leadership team, which also has four System Test Managers, where you will be one.

The level of experience in the team spans from newly graduates to more than +20 years of experience. Our team members have different educational backgrounds that vary from satellite, aerospace, earth and space physics to mechanical and electrical engineering. We have created it in this way, because we believe that bringing people with different competences together will generate the best solutions.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Director Integration, Test & Verification, Lars Boye on lrb@weibel.dk.

The deadline is the 22nd of November 2026.

Please be aware that it is a requirement for this position that you can provide a criminal record with no remarks and obtain a security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and proactive Student Worker with an interest in corporate communications, storytelling and digital channels to join Genmab’s global Communications & Corporate Affairs (C&CA) team.

Based in our Copenhagen office, you will work closely with another Student Worker in Copenhagen and collaborate with Communications colleagues across our global organization, including Denmark, The Netherlands and the United States.

You will contribute to a broad range of internal communications activities, supporting global initiatives as well as local employee engagement and communications activities in Denmark and the Netherlands, including corporate and R&D-related communications.

This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in corporate communications within an innovative, international biotechnology company. The position reports to the Senior Director, Communications, based in Princeton, New Jersey, USA.

This position is intended for students currently enrolled in academic programs and is approximately 15-20 hours per week, with flexibility around studies.

**About The Enterprise Internal Communications Team

**Our purpose is to strengthen internal communications across Genmab as the company grows, ensuring colleagues receive clear, consistent and engaging communication that connects them to our strategy, scientific innovation and extra[not]ordinary® culture.

We coordinate communications across our anchor sites in Denmark, the Netherlands and the United States.

The **Role

**You’ll help plan and deliver our editorial content, coordinate digital channels, plus support events and office communications in Copenhagen.

You will support the planning, creation and delivery of internal communications editorial content, help coordinate our digital channels and contribute to employee engagement activities across Genmab.

Working with colleagues in Copenhagen and across our global team, you will gain experience in communications planning, content creation, digital engagement and event support.

You will also have opportunities to contribute to communications highlighting Genmab’s innovative R&D activities, scientific achievements and the people behind our science, particularly in collaboration with our teams in the Netherlands.

**Responsibilities

**

• Internal communications and storytelling: Support the execution of Genmab’s global internal communications strategy by creating engaging content for our corporate intranet, Viva Engage and other internal channels.

• R&D and scientific storytelling: Collaborate with communications colleagues and R&D teams, particularly in the Netherlands, to develop accessible, people-centric stories highlighting scientific innovation, research milestones, team achievements and employee experiences.

• Digital communications: Support the coordination and management of digital communications channels, including digital signage across our global offices, from content requests through publication.

• Corporate branding: Collaborate with our Corporate Branding team to refresh reception-area content and other visual communications materials.

• Employee engagement and events: Plan and execute employee events, town halls, leadership meetings and engagement activities, both globally and locally, with a particular focus on Copenhagen and virtual support for the Netherlands.

• Content creation: Assist with interviews, writing, editing and producing various deliverables including articles, presentations, visuals and short-form video content.

• Analytics and continuous improvement: Track the performance of our content, identify opportunities for improvement and contribute creative ideas to enhance employee engagement.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work with colleagues across C&CA, R&D and other functions to coordinate communications activities and ensure timely delivery of content.

**Requirments

**

• You are currently studying Communications, Marketing, Business and Administration, or a related field as a bachelor or master’s student with an interest in digital communication

• You are interested in the pharma/biotech industry and the unique role that Corporate Communications plays across various internal and external audiences.

• You are confident communicating in English and interested in writing and storytelling

• You are organized, detail-oriented and take ownership of your work and your relationships with stakeholders.

• You have strong digital skills and are familiar with tools such as Microsoft 365 and PowerPoint. Experience with SharePoint, video editing, digital analytics or emerging AI tools is an advantage.

• You are proactive, curious and eager to learn, with a flexible and solution-oriented mindset

• You are a generous collaborator who enjoys working in an international team, both on-site and virtually, and you like to have fun along the way.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK180,00---180,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**The Impact You'll Make

**As a Production Engineer at Danfoss Silkeborg in our plastic moulding department, you will play a key role in developing, maintaining, and improving our plastic injection moulding processes that produce plastic components for some of Danfoss' most iconic products - the radiator thermostats and its valve - made right here in Silkeborg.

You will be instrumental in ensuring that our plastic injection moulding processes remain capable, reliable, and ready to meet future customer demands.

You will work alongside a team of 11 skilled Production Engineers, where you will take part of the ownership of our plastic injection moulding processes and related production equipment. Working closely with operators, tool technicians, maintenance, quality, and product development teams, you will drive process optimization, troubleshoot complex production challenges, validate new products and materials, and implement robust solutions that ensure stable and efficient production.

This role offers the opportunity to combine hands-on engineering, problem-solving, and continuous improvement in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where new technologies, products, and materials are continuously introduced and your will have a direct impact on product quality, process capability, equipment uptime and productivity.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You'll work closely with operators, tool technicians, maintenance specialists, quality engineers, and product development teams to improve process performance and support the introduction of new products, materials, and technologies.

**You Will

**

• Own and continuously improve plastic injection moulding processes, ensuring safe, stable, and efficient production performance

• Optimize moulding parameters, cycle times, material utilization, and process capability to increase productivity, capacity, and reduce waste

• Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of process deviations, quality issues, scrap, and equipment downtime, implementing sustainable solutions

• Introduce and validate new products, materials, tooling, and equipment, ensuring smooth implementation and integration into production

• Strengthen process and quality control through structured methods such as APQP, process validation, PFMEAs, control plans, and maintenance strategies

**What We're Looking For

**To succeed in this role, you'll combine technical expertise with a practical, hands-on approach to solving manufacturing challenges.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Technical background within plastic processing, injection moulding, production engineering, mechanical engineering, toolmaking, polymer engineering, or a related field

• Strong understanding of injection moulding processes, tooling, polymer materials, and production optimization

• Ability to combine analytical thinking with practical problem-solving on the shop floor

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset when working across functions and with external partners

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken

Experience with APQP, PFMEA, process validation, continuous improvement methodologies, or quality management systems will be considered an advantage.

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you'll join an experienced and collaborative engineering environment where you'll have the opportunity to influence products manufactured in high volumes and used in homes around the world.

You'll work with advanced injection moulding technologies and play a key role in introducing new products, materials, and manufacturing solutions, while being supported by knowledgeable colleagues who value teamwork, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

jobs.occupation: Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a fixed-term position as Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design, is open for appointment from January 1, 2027, or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is 2 years.

Your work tasks
Your work will include developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models based on circuit data, board geometries, simulation results and design images. You will develop surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic solvers, enabling faster evaluation of design alternatives. The position may also involve computer vision for recognizing circuit structures, component placements and printed circuit board geometries from photographs or other images. In addition, you will investigate graph-based methods for representing circuit relationships, evaluating design rules and generating or testing hypotheses for circuit designs. You will contribute to the development and verification of agentic workflows, where artificial intelligence systems combine models, tools and design rules to reason through and support electronics design tasks. You will prepare datasets, document computational workflows, validate model performance and share results with colleagues working in artificial intelligence, power electronics, semiconductors and software development.

The position is offered within the research field of Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design and contributes to AAU Energy’s focus areas of Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, and Energy Efficiency in Components and Systems. The Research Assistant will be affiliated with the Section of Power Electronics System Integration and Materials.

Your competencies
You have a relevant master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, artificial intelligence or a related field, and you are interested in working at the intersection of machine learning and power electronics design. You have a solid foundation in applied machine learning. Familiarity with electronic systems, including printed circuit boards, circuit topologies, components and the physical principles that influence electrical, thermal and electromagnetic performance, will help you engage with the engineering context of the role.

You have practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models, and you can translate complex engineering challenges into data-driven methods suited to a research environment. jobs.occupation: Intern auditor til informationssikkerhed i Region Midtjylland - tidsbegrænset stilling
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at styrke informationssikkerheden i en af Danmarks største offentlige organisationer?

I Region Midtjylland søger vi en intern auditor, der skal bidrage til at evaluere og videreudvikle regionens ledelsessystem for informationssikkerhed. Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med at sikre, at krav til informationssikkerhed efterleves, og at regionens politikker, procedurer og sikkerhedsforanstaltninger fungerer efter hensigten.

Som intern auditor skal du planlægge og gennemføre interne audits på tværs af organisationen og medvirke til at skabe overblik over styrker, risici og forbedringsmuligheder, som understøtter ledelsens beslutningsgrundlag. Du bliver samtidig en vigtig sparringspartner, der understøtter en kultur, hvor audit opleves som et redskab til læring, udvikling og løbende forbedring af informationssikkerheden.

 

Dine primære opgaver

Du får ansvar for at etablere og videreudvikle regionens proces for intern audit samt udarbejde og vedligeholde et risikobaseret auditprogram.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

• Udarbejde regionens auditprogram
• Planlægge og gennemføre interne audits i overensstemmelse med auditprogrammet og gældende krav til informationssikkerhed
• Fastlægge auditmål, auditkriterier og auditomfang
• Indsamle og vurdere dokumentation, interviewoplysninger, observationer og øvrige revisionsbeviser
• Vurdere efterlevelsen af ISO 27001 samt regionens politikker, retningslinjer og procedurer
• Identificere afvigelser, risici, forbedringsmuligheder og eksempler på god praksis
• Udarbejde rapporter og præsentere auditresultater for ledelse og relevante interessenter
• Bidrage til opfølgning på identificerede forbedringsområder
• Sikre, at eksisterende audits, tilsyn, it-revisioner og øvrige kontrolaktiviteter inddrages aktivt, så allerede tilgængelig viden udnyttes bedst muligt
 

Om dig

Vi søger en intern auditor, der er tillidsvækkende i dialogen med andre og formår at skabe gode og konstruktive samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af organisationen. Du møder medarbejdere og ledere med en anerkendende og respektfuld tilgang og udviser tålmodighed i auditprocessen. Samtidig har du modet til at identificere og påpege fejl, mangler og forbedringsmuligheder på en saglig og konstruktiv måde. Du ser intern audit som et redskab til læring og kvalitetsudvikling frem for kontrol.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at du:

• Er analytisk stærk og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til klare konklusioner
• Har gode skriftlige og mundtlige formidlingsevner
• Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt
• Evner at skabe samarbejde og tillid på tværs af forskellige fagområder
• Har kendskab til informationssikkerhed og ISO27001
 

Hvem er vi?

Du bliver ansat i informationssikkerhedsteamet i Digital Forvaltning, som er en del af Region Midtjyllands samlede informationssikkerhedsfunktion. Funktionen er et samarbejde mellem Sikkerhed og Compliance, som er en del af Digitalisering og It samt Juridisk Kontor og Digital Forvaltning, som er en del af Regionssekretariatet. 

Digital Forvaltning arbejder for at fremme digitalisering og sikre en systematisk, fælles ramme for informationssikkerhedsarbejdet i hele regionen. Vi er en del af Regionssekretariatet, der også varetager sekretariatsbetjening af regionsråd og direktion samt en række tværgående opgaver.

Arbejdssted: Regionshuset Viborg, Skottenborg 26, 8800 Viborg

 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår 

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset frem til den 31. december 2028 med evt. mulighed for forlængelse.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Ansøgningsfrist den 5. december 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt den 15. december 2026.  

Tiltrædelse: 1. februar 2027 eller efter aftale. 

Løn– og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. 

 

Yderligere information om stillingen

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Rikke Stein, Kontorchef i Digital Forvaltning, på telefonnummer 21359030 eller på mail rikke.stein@rm.dk.

 

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk
